title: Elodie and the Contact
author: Mara Yarrow
blurb: Ansel Reyes, a financial-crimes investigator drowning in clean money, works cases no one wants attributed. But when a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must trade the one secret worth killing for before the extraction flight leaves at dawn.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
